name: Scaffold a module-gated Partner Portal page
description:
### Why?

The Partner Portal needs a first extension point in the admin for upcoming Marketplace functionality, without exposing anything to projects that don't have the Partner Portal module enabled. Shipping the gated shell on its own keeps the later feature work small and reviewable.

### What?

A placeholder Partner Portal page in the admin, reachable only when the `partnerPortal` module is active on the project. Projects without the module must see no navigation entry and must not reach the page by URL. The package gets the layer boundaries needed for future partner API integration — no live partner API call in this task.

### Acceptance Criteria

Placeholder Partner Portal page renders in the admin as a React/Inertia page

Page is reachable only when 

partnerPortal

 is active for the project; inactive projects get no navigation entry and no URL access

A single controller provides the page entry point

The package declares application, contract, and infrastructure boundaries for future partner API calls, mirroring the 

Marketplaces

 layering

Module gate is covered by tests (active → renders, inactive → access denied)

### Technical notes

_Brief generated by Codex on 2026-07-31._

- The `partnerPortal` module row is assumed to already exist in production; this task only reads it, it does not create it. Worth confirming first — `partnerPortal` has no occurrence in the cms4 repo (nearest existing module is `apiPartner`).
- Module gating pattern: `Shoptet\Crm\Model\Modules::isActive()`, as in `cms/packages/Marketplaces/Presentation/MarketplaceRequiredModulesChecker.php`.
- Layered reference is `cms/packages/Marketplaces` (`Application` / `Domain` / `Infrastructure` / `Presentation`), not the 5-file `cms/packages/Marketplace`.
- Page registration goes through a `cms2_admin_section_map` migration with `module = 'partnerPortal'`.
- New admin pages use typed `{Page}PageProps` DTO props (see `st-archetype-inertia-props`).
- Confirm the intended Partner Portal navigation location while implementing.
